title: Coverage Determination Conditions for Rental Property Service Requests
content:
A failure reported on a Rental Property Service Contracts contract is covered only when every condition below holds, and otherwise is not covered with the first failing reason in this order.

| Order | Denial reason when the condition fails | Condition that must hold |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | contract not in force | the contract was active on the request date |
| 2 | waiting period | the failure was first reported on or after the coverage effective date and, for an item or higher cap added by a mid-term upgrade, at least the tier's upgrade waiting period (30 calendar days) after the last plan change date |
| 3 | item not in plan | the tier's cap for the item is above $0.00 |
| 4 | pre-existing condition | conditions existing before the coverage effective date are covered only when unknown, undetectable and the tier covers unknown pre-existing failures |
| 5 | tenant damage | failures caused by a tenant's misuse, abuse or damage are covered only when the tier covers tenant damage |
| 6 | misuse or external damage | other misuse and external causes (weather, pests, fire, flood, freezing in a unit left without heat) are never covered |
| 7 | cap exhausted | the remaining per-unit item benefit and the remaining aggregate benefit under the benefit authorization rules are both above zero |

No tier covers unknown pre-existing failures or tenant damage, so conditions 4 and 5 hold only when no pre-existing condition and no tenant damage is involved.

An initial determination is issued once per service request. After a landlord-requested second opinion, one review determination replaces the initial outcome.

## Applying the order (hypothetical requests)

- A request on a contract that was suspended on the request date, for a failure caused by a tenant: not covered, reason **contract not in force** — the first failing condition decides.
- A kitchen appliance request on Bridgewell Rental Systems: not covered, reason **item not in plan** (the cap is $0.00).
- A heating failure reported 20 days after an upgrade added heating cover: not covered, reason **waiting period**; reported 30 days after, condition 2 holds for it.
